mapper.update: UPDATE trading_stock_master SET is_trading_halt = TRUE, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE is_trading_halt = FALSE AND deleted_at IS NULL AND stock_code NOT IN ( SELECT DISTINCT stock_code FROM trading_price_history WHERE trade_datetime >= #{cutoff} )

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trading_stock_master (stock_code, stock_name, market_type, is_auto_selected) VALUES (#{stockCode}, #{stockName}, #{marketType}, TRUE) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE stock_name = VALUES(stock_name), market_type = VALUES(market_type), is_auto_selected = TRUE, deleted_at = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
